title: Constantin Turculet(?) to Hetman Sieniawski(?), news from Bender, 1709 (DECODE R7481, R7482)

documents.shelfmark: Archiwum Narodowe w Krakowie, Zbiór Dzieduszyckich 26/32 nr 5 pp. 1-3 and 5-6; DECODE R7481, R7482

plaintext.source: full interlinear decipherment; p. 3 is a fair copy of the decipherment of pp. 1-2; key B printed by Kaczka 2012 fn. 22, plaintext unpublished

transcription.notes: R7481 522 tokens (520 read; 407 and 700 unglossed nulls), R7482 355 (all read); second pass sien/R7481_pass2.txt, R7482_pass2.txt.

system.summary: A numerical substitution, comma-separated (key B, the Turculet key of Kaczka 2012 fn. 22: a=37 b=51 c=71 d=100 e=1 ... z=27), with a few code numbers and nulls (407, 700); Polish and Latin.
system.sibling_key: Kaczka 2012 fn. 22 (key B); used to check the interlinear decipherment

prior_solution.where: the contemporary interlinear decipherment; key B printed by Kaczka 2012 fn. 22, the letters not printed

conditions.human_role: Project-level: DECODE login cookie supplied and the target assigned in a brief (catalogue entry 333). No target-specific intervention.
tools: DECODE JSON API and filesrv download

solution.what: DECODE metadata for R7460-R7507 by API; 130 images of R7462-R7507 with the session cookie; no key or decryption file on any record.

Kaczka, Danubius XXX (2012) prints the Brâncoveanu/Cantacuzino letters of nr 13 and nr 5 from these originals with keys A and B; nothing on the Schenck letters, R7475, R7476, R7481-R7482, R7484-R7485.

Subagents transcribed the unprinted Sieniawski pieces with their interlinear decipherments: R7475 (alphabetical homophonic table rebuilt from the gloss), R7476 and R7484-R7485 (Chomentowski's 3-digit syllabary, syllabary.tsv), R7481-R7482 (key B).
R7481, R7482, R7484, R7485 checked token by token against gloss and key (encipherment slips settled): 99.6%, 100%, 95.9%, 100% read as sense.

Entry split on 14 Oct 2026 from sieniawski1708 under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): the Vienna-Schenck letters are schenck1706; the Sieniawski letters are one entry per key: key A (sieniawski1708), key B (turculet1709), the R7475 table (r7475), the Chomentowski syllabary (chomentowski1713).

outcome.method_basis: Both letters carry a full contemporary interlinear decipherment (and p. 3 a fair copy of it), transcribed and checked token by token against Kaczka's key B; his edition did not print these letters.
outcome.fraction_read_source: R7481_pass2.txt: 520 of 522 tokens give sense (the two open are the nulls 407, 700); R7482_pass2.txt: 355 of 355; 875 of 877
